section: 2.A.ii, Discussion on Graduation Rate, printed page3
paraphrase: Members described graduation credit for online schools determined by the last submitted exit code, regardless of where the last class occurred. They discussed considering FTE and dates in a potential rule and difficulties with prior-year graduate corrections. These minutes do not establish an adopted replacement rule or explain the observed school-versus-district count discrepancy.
